propositions: Replace the module-size allowlist/exemption system with an absolute 800-LOC cap enforced via a single-source limit file.
Add .github/module-size-limit.txt containing 800 as the single authoritative source for the module-size limit, readable by both CI workflows and contract tests.
Rewrite the Module-size gate in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to read the limit file, apply an absolute cap with no allowlist, and reject any src/rebar Python file exceeding the limit.

Implement limit-lock behavior: fetch main's limit file by explicit GitHub URL, compare its value to the current limit, and fail with override-required message if they differ; warn (not silently skip) on fetch failure.
Retain the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files during Phase 2a so main's current gate remains green on this change's CI; Phase 2b will delete them.

Update test_module_size_contract.py to read the cap from the limit file and assert no src/rebar file exceeds it; update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to recognize module-size-limit.txt as a shared gate signature.
